note: Proposed evidence units for the three rows #627 D1 asks about. Every member is a corpus row whose text was read; every canonical is the address the Golden Set requires. Status is 'proposed': a curator signs or rejects each unit, and nothing here is a finding about which narration is authoritative.

units.evidence: One isnad: Ahmad bin Hanbal -> Waki' -> Zakariya bin Ishaq -> Yahya bin Abdullah bin Shayfiy -> Abu Ma'bad -> Ibn Abbas. Two collections carry the same transmission of the Mu'adz zakat report.

Different companions and chains (Ali bin Abu Thalib; Abdullah bin Amru) but a near-identical matn: 'these two things are forbidden to the men of my community', of gold and silk. Equivalence is a curation judgement, not a chain fact.

Three narrations of one permission: Bukhari 1108 (Salim from his father), Nasai 598 (Nafi' from Ibn Umar), Malik 326 (Abu Hurairah, the Tabuk journey). A unit may hold these only if the requirement is the ruling rather than the narration.
units.requiresDecision: Does the Golden Set require the ruling or the report?
